queue_script:
param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][datetime]$StopAt)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Lane = 'C:/Work/Lanes/CodexTactics-149b'
$Freeze = '77f2e9f55857669deab099b144e77840d47e9425'
Set-Location $Lane
if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne $Freeze) { throw '149b lane moved from its freeze; refusing baseline' }
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING = 'utf-8'
& python Scripts/Trainer/metric_campaign.py --config Saved/Trainer/149b-input/trainer_config.json --run-id 149b-freeze-baseline --rounds 30 --freeze-sha $Freeze --parallel 2 --stop-at $StopAt.ToString('s')
$BaselineExit = $LASTEXITCODE
$Evidence = 'Saved/Trainer/149b-freeze-baseline/evidence.json'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Evidence) {
    $Doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Evidence -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($Doc.rounds) -Depth 50 | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 Saved/Trainer/149b-freeze-baseline/probe_rows.json
    & python Scripts/Trainer/night_trainer.py --config Saved/Trainer/149b-input/trainer_config.json --check-gate --gate-baseline $Evidence --gate-probe Saved/Trainer/149b-freeze-baseline/probe_rows.json --gate-sweep Saved/Logs/SmokeParallel-worker.json
    Write-Host "149b baseline complete=$($Doc.complete) counts=$($Doc.counts | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) G3=$($Doc.g3_sufficient); training gate exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
}
exit $BaselineExit
